steps.text: Bring a rope, and great fireball or thunderstorm runes for the crowded floor.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope, Stuff to kill Heroes and minor creatures, recommended GFBs or Thunderstorms

steps.text: Go down into the Edron Hero Cave.
steps.source: Go into the Edron Hero Cave, here (Mapper Coords 129.140, 123.150, 7).

steps.text: Follow the cave down five floors: wild warriors, demon skeletons, a beholder, monks, then dragons and a hero.
This floor is crowded (wild warriors, stalkers, hunters, priestesses, demon skeletons): clear it with great fireballs or thunderstorms, then go down in the south.
steps.source: Note: You probably need to use Great Fireballs or Thunderstorms in image #6.

steps.text: Past the monks and down to the bedroom (priestesses and a hero).
The time ring is in the drawers on the west.
steps.source: Use the chests to get your reward.

steps.text: The sword ring is in the drawers on the east.
steps.source: Use the chests to get your reward.
